insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: PED waiting period 36 months ( For pre existing diseases other than the pre-existing Disability and HIV/AIDS covered)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases (other than the pre-existing disability and HIV/AIDS covered) are covered after a waiting period of 36 months. Claims for these conditions will not be payable until you complete 3 continuous years on the policy.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: First 30 days waiting period- Code- Excl03
good.explanation: A 30-day initial waiting period applies for illnesses (Excl03). Non-accident claims in the first 30 days are not payable, which is standard in retail health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Specified disease/procedure waiting period- Code- Excl02 ... excluded until the expiry of 24months
good.explanation: Specified diseases/procedures (Excl02) are excluded until the expiry of 24 months. Claims for these listed conditions become payable only after 2 years of continuous coverage.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: for a fixed period of 30 days prior to the date of admissible Hospitalization
good.explanation: Medical expenses are covered for 30 days prior to the date of admissible hospitalization. This helps pay for pre-admission consultations, tests, and medicines linked to the hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: for a fixed period of 60 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital
good.explanation: Medical expenses are covered for 60 days from the date of discharge from the hospital. This supports follow-up treatment costs, but anything beyond 60 days will not be covered.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Any treatment for the pre-existing disability covered, will have a waiting period of 24 months from the first policy inception date.
good.reference: Section 6 (Specific Conditions Applicable for Persons with Disability)
good.explanation: Treatment for the pre-existing disability covered has a waiting period of 24 months from the first policy inception date. Claims related to that pre-existing disability are not payable until you complete 2 years on the policy.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home up to maximum of 1% of the Sum Insured per day.
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped at 1% of the Sum Insured per day. If you choose a room costing more than this limit, you may face higher out-of-pocket costs (and related deductions) on the hospitalization bill.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Each and every claim under the Policy shall be subject to a Co-payment of 20% ... This co-payment can be waived off by paying an additional premium(optional).
bad.explanation: A 20% co-payment applies to each and every claim by default, unless you pay extra premium to waive it. This means you pay 20% of the admissible bill on every claim, which is a major cost burden.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: subject to a limit of Rs.40,000/-, per each eye in one policy year.
bad.explanation: Cataract treatment is limited to ₹40,000 per eye per policy year. If the actual cataract package cost is higher, you will have to pay the difference yourself.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: will be covered ... up to 50% of Sum Insured
bad.explanation: Modern treatments are covered only up to 50% of the Sum Insured. This can significantly reduce payouts for expensive advanced procedures even when you have remaining Sum Insured.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Non-Payable items: The expenses that are not covered in this Policy are placed under List -I of Annexure-11
bad.reference: Section 8.2(17) and Annexure II (Non-Medical Expenses / List I)
bad.explanation: Items listed as non-payable under List I (Annexure II) are excluded from cover. This typically leads to routine out-of-pocket costs for consumables and other non-medical hospital charges.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: Maximum liability of the Company under all such Claims paid under indemnity, during each Policy Year shall be the Sum Insured opted and specified in the Schedule.
bad.explanation: The insurer’s maximum liability in a policy year is limited to the Sum Insured shown in the Schedule, with no mention of any restoration/reinstatement. Once the Sum Insured is exhausted, further claims in the same policy year may not be payable.

unclear.name: No Claim Bonus
unclear.quote: Maximum liability of the Company under all such Claims paid under indemnity, during each Policy Year shall be the Sum Insured opted and specified in the Schedule.
unclear.reference: Section 2 (Operating Clause) / Table of Benefits (no NCB field shown)
unclear.explanation: No clear No Claim Bonus (increase in Sum Insured for claim-free years) is stated in the provided wording extract. You should verify the Policy Schedule/benefit table to confirm whether any NCB applies and how it changes after a claim.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
